note: Held-out real-text batch for German segment.inConstituents and segment.inMorphemes, round 5 of #1241, authored 2026-10-25 as Draft Breakdown Records in records/breakdown/de. Its 30 targets were sampled uniformly at random from the sentences tf-demo's Learners read (see sampling), and gold was authored only after sampling, so no target was replaced, skipped or reordered for being easy, hard or odd; rows RT1 to RT30 follow draw order. Three accepted draws were excluded after sampling and replaced by the next accepted draws, 80, 82 and 84 (see sampling): draw 74, PROPN Hohen-Cremmen, which the two judges agreed to drop (its inflected adjective first part is a structural snag); draw 8, ADJ schlimm, because its unit call is contested (the gold author argues the sampled unit is NOUN das Schlimmste, under Rule de/neuter-adjectival-noun, which would take a Source), and draw 54, anschließen in sich jmdm. anschließen, because of a structural snag: no Breakdown for a lexically reflexive one-word Lexeme passes the checker (it also hits ADR 0050's sich erinnern), and a structural fix follows round 5. The lab scores these records in segment-in-constituents/de:realtext, the round's headline set, and its bottom words in segment-in-morphemes/de:realtext. Gold: 22 of 30 have no Constituents, so they are NoConstituents cases for segment.inConstituents and morphemes cases for segment.inMorphemes: 11 declinable bottom words with a Root and an Ending (verbs geben, heißen, haben, sagen, wissen, weinen, können with en; nouns and adjectives Herr, kurz, Gefahr, Weihnachten with ∅), 8 indeclinables with a Root and no Ending (hin, schon, nur, erst, noch, gar, und, ja), and 3 proper names with a Root and ∅ (Kopp, Schrimm, Varzin). 8 have Constituents: 4 derivations (Genesung = genesen + -ung, jugendlich = Jugend + -lich, gnädig = Gnade + -ig, erkennen = er- + kennen), 3 particle verbs (mitnehmen, zuhören, abfallen) and 1 phraseme (zu Gast sein = zu · Gast · sein). No compound was drawn, and no target has a Source. Every word split follows the DWDS Wortzerlegung, and every bottom word is one DWDS gives none (ADR 0050's tie rule), each cited in its record. Debatable calls, for the judges: Weihnachten (DWDS gives it no Wortzerlegung, only a formal link to Weihnacht, whose Wortzerlegung is weihen Nacht; gold keeps it a bottom word); Gefahr (DWDS's Etymologie calls mhd. gevāre a ge- formation on obsolete Fahr, but no Wortzerlegung confirms the cut, so ge- stays in the Root as in Geselle); Kopp, Schrimm and Varzin (no dictionary splits them; a PROPN takes ∅ by German's morpheme policy); gar (DWDS derives the adverb from the adjective gar, but no Source is produced on an ADV). Judged 2026-10-25 by two judges, system and learner POV (#1241); their agreed changes are applied and their splits are listed on #1241, none of them changing a gold Breakdown; none may be an example in a Breakdown prompt (#693).

Its Lemma is not already Breakdown gold
